hiace.title: Toyota Hiace
hiace.desc: The gold standard in NZ. Known for being indestructible. Plenty of parts available and amazing resale value. Perfect for long-term travel.

caravan.title: Nissan Caravan
caravan.desc: The best alternative to the Hiace. Often slightly more affordable and offering similar interior space. A solid and reliable workhorse for your adventure.

delica.title: Mitsubishi Delica
delica.desc: A bit more compact and practical if you're traveling solo or as a duo on a budget. Easy to park, easier on fuel, and still fits everything you need.

elgrand.title: Nissan Elgrand
elgrand.desc: Known as the 'King of Vans'. A more luxury choice for those seeking superior interior comfort and a smooth ride. Very popular for high-end conversions.
